scope: Local synthetic input selection and mocked decoder invocation; no actual genesis decoding or worker execution
change: Feed the selected genesis byte snapshot directly to bounded decoder stdin; refuse named pipes without waiting for a writer and reject empty files or invalid selectors.

validation.skipReason: Existing Linux-only process-name check on a non-Linux development host.
checks: A real named pipe with no writer refuses within a bounded child process.
Empty selected input and non-string digest selectors refuse.
A mocked decoder receives exactly the admitted genesis bytes without a shell or reopened genesis path.
A later selected-file mutation fails the post-review check and retains the decoded output and failed attempt.
Completed and failed attempt namespaces are not overwritten.

limitations: The decoder invocation is supplied by the test fixture; no actual account bytes, custody or consensus were verified.
Existing retained worker attempts and decoder artifacts were not modified or rerun.
This changes the authority review reader only. The retained allocation-byte rehearsal driver and fresh preparer integration remain separate work.
File selection and executable checks do not establish independent operator custody or production security.
